profile.headline: Software Engineer of the US Tools and Monitoring Services at Atos
profile.summary:
•	Experienced UNIX/Linux Engineering
•	Experienced UNIX/Linux Senior Administration
•	Proficient Server and Infrastructure Engineering/Administration for hundreds of servers/environments
•	Experienced Team Lead, able to supervise and allocate team resources, and update project plans
•	Amazon AWS console Administration, implementing RHEL ISO images in regions around the globe, including support of IT and Business groups
•	Quest Private Cloud Administration, implementing RHEL ISO images with various Applications, including support of IT and Business groups
•	Used various Server Management tools including Amazon AWS console, Quest Cloud, VMware, VMware vCloud, and BladeLogic
•	Diligent in Infrastructure data management and record-keeping
•	Extensive customer service, research skills, organizational planning, and completing assignments efficiently with minimum supervision
•	Strong written and verbal communication skills for interactions with team, department and managers
•	Managed Vendor relationships with Oracle/Sun Microsystems and Red Hat
•	Project Lead for light projects using a small project team, using resources inside and outside my department
•	Able to work well independently or within a project group or team group
•	Execution of various Shell scripting

positions.description:
•	Unix/Linux Server Engineering group responsible for engineering, architect, document creation, 3rd level support, and create standards/patterns for the UNIX/Linux eco-system, including physical servers and VMware virtual servers.
•	Unix/Linux Server Administration group responsible for administration, 1st and 2nd level support for Unix/Linux eco-system, including physical servers and VMware virtual servers.
•	Part of a 24x7x365 On-Call First Response team

positions.description:
•	Expert level knowledge in designing, implementing and testing complex infrastructure and application hosting
•	Able to capture, document and utilize customer and technical requirements to support projects
•	Project support from Initiate through production turnover

positions.title: Service Architect of Architect and IT Services Group
positions.description:
•	Collaborates with S&P Global Enterprise Architecture to aligns IT road maps with business strategy
•	Recommends future state architecture and defines IT service strategy
•	Responsible for end to end service creation of Contract Change Requests (CR)
•	Redefined the Service Architecture Workflow documentation by streamlining tasks and working with various groups to update processes

positions.title: Lead Unix/Linux Engineer of Product Architecture Group
(UNIX) Product Engineer of Product Engineering
positions.description:
I am working for Atos at the McGraw-Hill account

MHP Cloud Initiatives 
- Provide Server Eng support for Private Cloud projects
- Provide Server Eng support for Public Amazon Cloud projects
- Successful roll-out of RHEL image for all Cloud projects
- Engineered Server Automation scripts for Private and Public Cloud projects
- Assisted Business Customers on an as-needed basis with their various issues

UNIX/Linux Domain Team Member
- Develop appropriate technology patterns for global UNIX eco-system.
- Incorporated Domain Team standards and objectives into the UNIX build standards
- Communicate standards to all respective Domain Teams

Product Life Cycle Management
- Created or significantly contributed to RHEL and Solaris PLCM documentation
- Managed MHP Product Roadmap for the UNIX family in both software (OS, Apps) and hardware (server models)

Project Management
- Fulfill Solutions Design and Implementation roles for all Server Engineering initiatives.
- Significant Contributions to these projects:
- BladeLogic automation deployment roll-out, patching and server maintenance
- Quest Authentication Services (QAS) for UNIX
- EDMZ Internet Proxy servers for RHEL and Solaris registration and other communication
- Home-Grown Automated Employee Termination Script Engineer/Administrator; used on 400+ servers
- Oracle ASR Configuration and Roll-Out

Product Engineering Subject Matter Expert
- Provide product and/or ecosystem SME knowledge to the Solutions Design process. 
- Provide guidance towards sizing, usage patterns, and product sizing/scaling and cost estimates.
- Maintain dialog with other teams and improve documentation

Vendor Relationships
- Coordinated and ran all Oracle and Red Hat Vendor Quarterly Review meetings
- My Oracle Support (MOS) McGraw-Hill CSI Administration and Red Hat Network (RHN) McGraw-Hill Master Account (Ensured personnel from ALL support teams had access and resolved all access related issues)

positions.title: Senior Unix/Linux Engineer
positions.description: Provided personal IT consulting for specific projects.

positions.title: (UNIX) Server Engineer of (Corporate) Server Engineering
positions.description:
Corporate Global Operations and Infrastructure (GO&I)

One of 3 Server Engineers in the Server Engineering Dept. who engineer, create documentation, provide 3rd level support, and create standards/patterns for the Global UNIX eco-system (includes physical, VMware virtual, Private Cloud and Public Cloud {Amazon} servers) at McGraw-Hill.

•	Cloud Computing Engineer/ Facilitator
•	SUN Certified Systems Administrator for Solaris
•	Red Hat Certified Engineer for Enterprise Linux

Specialties: Cloud Computing, Server Engineering, Server Administration, Solaris, Red Hat Enterprise Linux

    * Created a web server with content and applications for increased productivity
    * Instrumental in Intranet development including TCP/IP and Netscape browser roll-out

positions.title: Department Supervisor

(Company name was formerly The Credit Bureau, Inc - CBI)

* Assisted the System Analyst on maintenance and troubleshooting of a UNIX Property Search system
    * Learned the languages of INFORMIX, ACEGO, and PERFORM to create sub-databases, forms and reports that interacted with the main database
    * Increased departmental productivity and efficiency so 4 people could do the work of 12
